name: U-XAI-IDS
description: Code, checkpoints, and the resumable evaluation harness for U-XAI-IDS, a unified benchmark scoring IDS explanations (SHAP, LIME variants, Integrated Gradients) on fidelity, stability, domain feasibility, inter-explainer agreement, and adversarial robustness across four detector families and two datasets (NSL-KDD, CICIDS2017). Introduces Domain-Constraint-Aware (DCA) perturbation and the Domain Feasibility Rate (DFR) metric. Paper PDF is available in the repository and as a linked Zenodo record.
